content:
maria: Heads-up — ShadowBox needs an assurance packet for the POC. They want a short SOC2 excerpt showing storage controls, a signed vulnerability attestation we can issue, redacted network diagram, and confirmation that an external scanner can run auth scans against our staging environment. They also asked whether providing presigned storage URLs + ephemeral KMS creds will change Dedicated pricing. Can ops/security confirm what we can produce and lead times?

ezra: I can assemble the SOC2 excerpt and the network diagram (redacted). For presigned URLs we usually do 24h TTLs and provide S3 presign commands. Example we give customers for uploads: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/shadowbox/scan-drop.zip --expires-in 86400
```
We do not hand over service creds — only presigned URLs or short-lived STS tokens. Ephemeral KMS/dek signing we can do but TTLs vary; default 1 hour.

olivia: Security notes: we permit third-party scanners under the following constraints — signed NDA, a named test window, scope limited to staging (no prod), only presigned read/write to a single bucket prefix, and we do not provide keys or admin-level access. We can issue a "vulnerability attestation" letter that states: scope, allowed IPs, test window, and a high-level statement that we consent to the scan and will remediate critical findings. That letter can be signed by our CISO. Lead time: 3 business days to review scope + legal approval, sooner if customer provides tester CV and exact IPs.

je:devsec-bot: Automated checklist generated -> make sure to include: SOC2 Storage excerpt PDF, redacted network diagram (no internal IPs), vulnerability attestation template, presign command example, required legal signoff. Link: https://drive.google.com/placeholder/assurance-shadowbox (internal) :white_check_mark:

\ejake (CISO): I can sign the attestation but Legal will need to review wording about liability and remediation SLAs. We should not promise timelines beyond our standard SLA. If they want a stronger attestation (e.g., guaranteed remediation windows or explicit pen-test liability coverage) escalate to Legal and Sales for contract addendum.

maria: Quick pricing question from buyer — "Will issuing presigned URLs or giving ephemeral KMS creds bump Dedicated pricing or require a new quote?"

ezra: Short answer: no for standard presigned usage. If they require VPC peering, dedicated tunnel, or an on-prem connector/agent that requires setup by our Infra team, that will incur a one-time engineering/setup fee and possibly higher monthly reserved capacity. Examples:
- presigned S3 + STS tokens = no pricing change.
- VPC peering / cross-account NAT / dedicated infra for scans = quote required.
We should call out that large sustained scanner traffic might trigger autoscale usage — that would be billed normally.

olivia: Also add that if tester needs to run authenticated API calls, we need scoped API keys for the staging tenant only and those keys must be rotated after the test. That is doable but ops will need 24–48h to create and revoke.

maria: Perfect. I'll get ShadowBox to sign the NDA and send tester details (scope + IPs + CV) by Wed. Any preferred format for the attestation?
\olj:devsec-bot: Use the standard attestation template located in the Assurance folder — customize scope and test window. Filename template: attestation-template-v2.docx.
\ejake (CISO): Final: I can sign once Legal clears wording. Maria, loop in legal and paste the exact scope. I won't sign open-ended bullet points.

maria: Will do. Next steps: I will a) upload SOC2 excerpt and redacted network diagram to the Drive link, b) request tester CV + IPs, c) confirm whether they want presigned URLs or scoped staging API key. Target: deliver draft attestation + SOC excerpt to ShadowBox by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:

ezra: I'll draft the pricing note we can attach to the attestation (clarifies no charge for presigned URLs, callout for peering/setup fees).

olivia: I'll draft the attestation language and include required constraints (no prod, timeboxed, IP allowlist, rotate creds).
\maria: Thanks everyone — tagging next steps: @ezra please add pricing blurb, @olivia draft attestation, @jake sign once legal ok. I'll update customer.

(attachments: link to SOC2 excerpt draft, redacted-diagram-v1.png, attestation-template-v2.docx)
